notes.subject: kgetho ya gagwe
notes.rationale: קצירו: 'kgetho/sejalo' (YLt 'crop') kgathanong le 'sepagare' (KJV, ba bangwe ba fetola ka go tšwa go Job 14:9)

notes.subject: e kgobetšwa
notes.rationale: ימל (go tšwa go נמל, go ripswa/go simolola) gape e ka balwa 'e a thunya' — go hloka moya; kgobetšo ke go balwa goba godimo

notes.subject: מתחת … ממעל
notes.rationale: tlase/godimo — kgethollo ya sebopego: modu o oma tlase, kgetho e kgobetšwa godimo

translation: Ka tlase medu ya gagwe di oma, gomme ka godimo kgetho ya gagwe e kgobetšwa.
